import argparse
import math
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

def main():
    # Create the PyChrono system
    system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
    system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -9.81, 0))

    # Create the MAN 10t truck vehicle
    vehicle = veh.ChTrackedVehicle()
    vehicle.SetName("MAN 10t Truck")
    vehicle.SetChassisFixed(True)
    vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.ChVehicleCollisionType.COLLISION_TYPE_NONE)
    vehicle.SetTireType(veh.ChTireType.TIRE_TYPE_TMEASY)
    vehicle.SetTireSteerAngle(0.0)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxSteerAngle(0.3)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxSlip(0.2)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxPressure(1.0)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxTemperature(100.0)
    vehicle.SetTireMinPressure(0.5)
    vehicle.SetTireMinTemperature(-20.0)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxWear(1.0)
    vehicle.SetTireMinWear(0.0)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxSlipRatio(0.5)
    vehicle.SetTireMinSlipRatio(-0.5)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxRollingResistance(0.02)
    vehicle.SetTireMinRollingResistance(0.005)
    vehicle.SetTireMaxRollingResistanceCoefficient(0.02)
    vehicle.SetTireMinRollingResistanceCoefficient(0.005)
